detail: Authors' dvips/Ghostscript render (SurveyAAL.dvi, created 2003-04-30) of the Studia Logica article; page 1 carries 'Special Issue on Abstract Algebraic Logic - Part II ... Studia Logica 74: 13-97, 2003. (c)2003 Kluwer Academic Publishers'. Same journal typesetting and pagination as the publication; it is not the Springer/Kluwer-distributed PDF, and word-for-word identity with that PDF was not checked. | 85 PDF pages = printed pp. 13-97, continuous (p.13 contents/title, pp.14-97 numbered, references end p.97 with [138]); all sections 1-6 and References (p.88) listed in contents present.

Author-typeset LaTeX/dvips copy (letter size; PDF regenerated 2023-10-11 by GPL Ghostscript 9.50 from dvips 5.86d), no MIT Press proceedings header and no printed page numbers; not the typeset ICLP/SLP 1988 proceedings pp. 1070-1080. | 11 PDF pages, unnumbered; complete paper text from title/abstract through references [1]-[15] (last page ends at [15]); no truncation. Correspondence to proceedings pages 1070-1080 cannot be checked (no running page numbers).

Author-hosted PDF (GNU Ghostscript 6.53, no CUP header, no DOI); running heads 'Jean-Yves Girard' / 'Linear logic : its syntax and semantics', self-references cite 'In this volume, 1995'. Not the CUP typeset chapter doi 10.1017/CBO9780511629150.002; its pagination 1-42 coincides with the published page range but textual identity with the CUP text is not established. | 42 PDF pages = printed pp. 1-42, continuous; begins with title and section 1 'The syntax of linear logic', ends with references through [19] on p.42.

On-line re-typeset edition: verso reads '(c) Cambridge University Press, 1989 / First Published 1989 / Reprinted with minor corrections 1990 / Reprinted for the Web 2003' (pdfTeX, created 2003-08-12). Incorporates the 1990 corrections and is re-typeset; not the 1989 first-printing pages. | 183 PDF pages: front matter i-viii (title, verso, preface, contents) + printed pp. 1-175 continuous through the index. Contains ch.11 System F (incl. 11.3-11.6 encodings, Curry-Howard), ch.14 normalisation of F, ch.15 representation theorem, appendix A Semantics of System F.

Photocopy scan (KMBT_500, OCR by Acrobat Paper Capture) of the printed 1989 volume pages: chapter '17 Demonstratives ... David Kaplan', pp. 481-563, matching Themes from Kaplan (OUP 1989) chapter numbering and pagination. Scan of the published edition. | 68 PDF pages, mostly two-page spreads: PDF p.1 = p.481, PDF pp.2-42 = pp.482-563 continuous (each spread checked by printed page numbers; p.506 OCR-misread as 505). PDF pp.43-68 additionally contain the separate 'Afterthoughts' (pp.565-614), outside the required extent.

Image-only scan (Photoshop, no text layer) of the printed Plenum 1972 volume pages, running heads 'RICHARD M. KARP' / 'REDUCIBILITY AMONG COMBINATORIAL PROBLEMS' with page numbers 86-103. Published typeset pages; no container title page in the file. | 19 PDF pages = printed pp. 85-103 continuous (p.85 unnumbered chapter opening, pp.86-103 numbered, verified from running heads); ends with Appendix I on p.103.
